text:
I shall be in your hands a fine cup

ready to sound when you wish to make it vibrate...

Springs will distill in it,

it will reflect the light that illumines you.


I shall be in your hands a fine cup.

You will have in it a gentle drink,

never sweeter, for pity grants it;

liquor that does no harm and forgives harm,

sweet liquor that knows of things...


You will have in it a gentle drink.

One dark day, between your long fingers

its gleaming crystal will be pressed

and the fine cup that gave you lethargies

will fall kindly into pieces;

one dark day, between your long fingers!


Formless crystal on the hard floor

shall not be cloudy because it is broken:

it will reflect the beatitude of heaven;

poor crystal thrown at your feet;

formless crystal on the hard floor.

May God forgive you damage so great:

blessed hands those that break it so,

may roses and lilies never thread them,

may eternal sweetness pay for its impiety.

May God forgive you damage so great...

translation.title: Ay!
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the cup image through service, fracture, and forgiveness.
